docs.title: From Amplify-and-Forward to Noisy Network Coding and Beyond
docs.text:
One question drives this book: What should a relay forward?

This book explains relay communication and network information theory from intuition first.

If you understand

\[ \text{received signal} = \text{transmitted signal} + \text{noise}, \]

you are ready to start.
